items.title: As Consumers Begin Their Holiday Shopping Season, Governor Hochul Signs Five-Year Ban on AI Chatbot Toys
items.rationale: Policy axis, primary document: New York enacted a five-year moratorium on making, distributing or selling toys with embedded AI chatbots, enforced by the AG with penalties of up to $15,000 per day. It is a hard product ban that hits toy and companion-AI builders directly.
items.excerpt: Hochul signed S.9408A/A.11144B, a five-year moratorium on making, distributing or selling toys with embedded AI chatbots in New York; AG-enforced civil penalties up to $15,000 per day per violation, effective 90 days after signing.

items.title: Character.AI Auction Of User Chats Faces CT Challenge
items.rationale: Privacy and liability axis, new filing: Connecticut AG Tong and 41 other states plus DC asked the bankruptcy court to block Character.AI's planned Dec. 1 auction of chat histories from more than 21M accounts unless deletion and use safeguards are in place. The objection is attributed to the AGs. The outlet is off-list; on-list outlets ran only commentary.
items.excerpt: Connecticut AG Tong, with 41 other states and DC, asks the bankruptcy court to reject Character.AI's planned Dec. 1 auction of chat histories from 21M+ US accounts (2.1M registered to minors) without deletion or use safeguards.

items.title: Statement on UK launch of Meta Muse
items.rationale: Regulator action, primary source: before Meta launched its Muse agentic AI in the UK, the ICO set out Meta's data-protection duties and secured a voluntary monitoring and reporting commitment. In a same-day blog post it reminded all consumer agentic-AI developers of their obligations.
items.excerpt: ICO CEO Paul Arnold says the regulator set out Meta's data-protection duties before the UK launch of its Muse agentic AI and that Meta committed to a voluntary monitoring and reporting scheme; a same-day ICO blog reminds consumer agentic-AI developers of their obligations.

items.title: “개인정보 보호법 인공지능 특례” 세부 기준 마련 … 개인정보 보호법 시행령 개정안 입법예고
items.rationale: Privacy rulemaking axis, official release: PIPC opened pre-announcement of an enforcement decree setting the safeguards, risk assessment and review procedure under which personal data may be processed for AI development. Comments run until 2027-01-04, and the law takes effect 2027-03-09.
items.excerpt: 개인정보위가 AI 개발 목적 개인정보 처리 특례의 안전조치·위험요인평가·심의·의결 절차를 담은 개인정보 보호법 시행령 개정안을 11월 23일부터 2027년 1월 4일까지 입법예고한다(법 2027-03-09 시행).

items.title: 행안부, '공공 AI 서비스 UI/UX 가이드라인' 마련… AI 안내·선택 기준 제시
items.rationale: Public-sector procurement and design-rule axis, official release: the Ministry of the Interior and Safety (행정안전부) issued 29 design standards for public AI services, covering AI role disclosure, tone, input handling and result verification. These are concrete rules for anyone building government AI interfaces.
items.excerpt: 행정안전부가 11월 25일 '공공 AI 서비스 UI/UX 가이드라인'을 배포한다. AI의 역할·말투부터 정보 입력, 결과 확인까지 29개 설계 기준과 적용 사례를 제시한다.
